notes.title: Update 5: New Scenario, Modding Improvements and More!
notes.content:
I've just released a new update for The Final Earth 2! This update adds a new scenario, new modding features, some new buildings and more!

The changelog is as follows:
-[b] New scenario: Hippie Commune![/b] The Blossom Hippies want to build a commune full of peace and love, and could use your help managing it. Will you build a idyllic commune, or maybe not?
- [b]New buildings: Pond Pod and Flower School. [/b]You'll discover a few scenario-specific buildings in the Hippie Commune scenario too.
- [b]Various new modding functions and improvements! [/b]This includes a way to easily add translations via mods, easily add buildings that can merge and much more. Check out [url=https://florianvanstrien.nl/TheFinalEarth2/modding.php]the modding docs[/url] for more info. If you're interesting in making your own mod, [url=https://tfe2-modding.github.io/index.html]also check out DT's new modding guide[/url] and [url=https://florianvanstrien.nl/discord.php]join my Discord to discuss modding[/url]!
- You can now see the all-time production of resources in the resource graph window (note: this only counts production from this update onwards)
- There's now an option to pick a color from your city for decorative elements and custom house colors.
- The Pond Park has a few extra plant variants
- Various bugfixes

Thank you for playing The Final Earth 2 and I hope you'll enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update 4: Side Missions and Decoration
notes.content:
Hi! Thank you for playing The Final Earth! This update contains the following:
[list]
[*] There are now some extra optional side missions. You'll find these during the 2nd and 3rd scenario and after completing the normal quests for the Secret Society, Hippies and Hackers. These side missions will unlock a new building, technology or building variation
[*] There are extra visual options for the wooden bridge, custom houses, slanted roofs and for floating platforms
[*] There is a new option to explain how you can increase the happiness
[*] The observatory can now be mirrored
[*] There are also several bugfixes, including for the party house and for sending people to an empty world using the rocket
[/list]
Thanks for reading and I hope you'll enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update 3: Custom Houses and the Pioneers' Hut
notes.content:
This update focuses on two new features: [b]Custom Houses[/b] and the [b]Pioneers' Hut[/b]. There are also various other improvements.

[h3]Custom Houses[/h3]
You can now design your own houses! Choose a design, colors and interior, and further customize your house with bonuses. Making a custom house is available quite early in the game. You will unlock further options for it throughout the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36129187/6c02312a397119982b134214f1d8897e78f095b5.png[/img]
[h3]Pioneers' Hut[/h3]
Some of your smartest citizens can now help you set up your city! Build the Pioneers' Hut and you'll occasionally get a choice of bonuses during the early game. These bonuses make the early game a bit faster and give you more options. For example, you can make houses cheaper or make your citizens get hungry less quickly. For the final bonus, you even get to choose from four new buildings to unlock for your city! Tip: build a Pioneers' Hut in multiple rocket-connected cities to unlock all these new buildings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36129187/c3f763a9fd583cd6a9b915dc62e633d805b54ce7.png[/img]
[h3]Other Improvements[/h3]
There are various other additions:
[list]
[*] New buildings: [b]Otherworldly Gardens [/b]and [b]Dome Otherworldy Gardens[/b]. These give you more options for your Otherworldly zoos.
[*] You can now favorite citizens
[*] The first time you don't have enough schools or homes, the game will give you a side mission to fix that
[*] The Spanish and Vietnamese translations have been improved, thanks to qanle and (Neo)³ from the community!
[/list]
Thanks for reading and I hope you'll enjoy this update!

notes.title: Halloween Event: make your city spooky!
notes.content:
Make your city more spooky with the halloween event, now live in game! During the halloween period, until November 3, you'll be able to unlock and place three new creepy buildings and an upgrade:
[list]
[*] The [b]Ghostly Garden[/b] is perfect to decorate your city, with cobwebs, creepy trees and more.
[*] The [b]Carved Pumpkin[/b] upgrade makes your citizens in Basic Houses happier.
[*] The [b]Horror Game Hall[/b] gives the perfect ambience for your citizens to play scary games.
[*] The [b]Haunted Laboratory[/b] can give you a lot of knowledge if you build multiple. But don't build too many, or bad things may happen...
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36129187/f7cf0021e98b334b3f5e8f91f52d49f8d079d112.png[/img]

The event ends on November 3. After that, you can keep any creepy buildings you placed in your city.

I wish you a very scary halloween!

notes.title: Update 1: The Colorful Update
notes.content:
With this update, you'll be able to make your city even more colorful, with colored blocks and rooftop elements in all the RGB colors! This should be very useful if you're one of the people who likes to make intricate designs with them, or just like to give your city some funky roofs. The city hall is also more useful, with two building modes to choose from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36129187/32ab9f498565f6e01249700baacd1aebfccdef51.png[/img]

Here are the full release notes:
- You can create colored blocks and rooftop elements in any RGB color
- Also in the colorful theme: There are more possible looks for citizens, so you'll see a bit more variation
- The City Hall workers no longer sit around doing nothing. Instead you can pick one of two small benefits
- You can now delete save files
- Bugfix: if you played the game very early on, you may not have gotten the achievement if you completed An Interworld City or The Spaceport. If that's the case for you, simply open the Start Scenario screen and it will be awarded.

notes.title: Patch 0.4
notes.content:
I've fixed the following issues:
- Saving to another file didn't work, and if you did try, switching between cities could result in errors
- Closing windows would get slower over time
Thanks very much to those who have reported them, I'm very sorry they got into the build!

If you cannot switch to another city, please do the following:
- Play your city on the newest version and note down on which save file you have saved it
- Go to %localappdata%\the-final-earth-2\User Data\Default\saves
- Find files starting with a number and then -RocketExplore and then some more. Rename them to start with the number you just noted MINUS ONE.

notes.title: Modding Support Preview
notes.content:
Official modding support has been a very popular request for The Final Earth 2. Today, I'm releasing the first step towards this with an update to the demo, adding a preview of modding functionality. This way, you can already start making mods before the full game release.

The options are limitless - add new buildings, upgrades, scenarios, materials, stats, or anything else you can think of!

See [url=https://florianvanstrien.nl/TheFinalEarth2/modding.php]here[/url] for a guide on how to make your own mod! Also, make sure to [url=https://discord.gg/r4H25JM]join my Discord[/url], if you haven't yet, to discuss with fellow modders and ask questions. You can also ask questions in the Steam community, of course.

For now, this is very much beta functionality - you need some coding knowledge, some functionality requires a deep dive into the game code, and crashes or bugs may occur. In particular, make sure to back up your save files regularly as I cannot guarantee saving functionality always works correctly with mods at the moment, and it is rather easy to make mistakes with implementing saving functions in your mods as well.

In addition to the modding support preview, this demo update also includes two new buildings and some quality of life improvements, such as:
[list]
[*] The tutorial is slightly quicker
[*] You can now replace all normal houses in one click
[*] An auto-upgrade option for labs
[*] The option to give your cities a name (as part of a new building)
[/list]

The demo will be available until at least the full version release, which I've currently planned for early 2021. Steam Workshop support will be available in the full version, too, so you can share and download mods more easily.

I hope you'll have fun with this new modding functionality. Your feedback is welcome! There have already been some really interesting mods without official support, and I hope this support makes it even easier.

Finally, I want to wish everybody very happy holidays!

Florian
